versions.content: AUTOSAR shall support tracing and profiling on the target and onboard Type: Draft Description: Each AUTOSAR module shall provide a standardized method and interface to enable tracing and profiling the software of AUTOSAR systems with awareness of the AUTOSAR architecture. Each part of the AUTOSAR software shall provide methods of obtaining event information to be used by trace analysis tools. Rationale: Tracing and timing analysis tools need internal information to visual ize and inspect the run - time behavior of the software. Components and modules implementing this requirement shall provide the necessary details and hooks that can be used by tools. Use Case: Run - time tracing the software, profiling, timing measurement.
